title: C04: Decide maintained roles for NFcore, NFcore2 and NFnext

source.contract: Consolidate NFcore2 capabilities into NFnext while promoting NFnext as the production default (method='nf' and selectable method='nfnext'), retaining NFcore as explicitly selectable method='nfcore', lowerPatternToNFsim for NFcore input, and containing unpromoted NFcore2 as an in-tree test oracle.

oracle.identity: Native NFsim at the revision in provenance/upstreams.lock.yml, in-repo NFcore comparator, analytical continuous-time Markov chain laws, and Catch2 architecture contracts
oracle.law: Detailed balance for reversible isomerization, exponential decay for pure death, backend identity (method='nf' and method='nfnext' select NFnext with backend 'nfnext'; method='nfcore' selects NFcore with backend 'nfsim'), NFcore-only option containment (equilibrate and traversal_limit require method='nfcore'), and fail-closed refusal of unpromoted method='nfcore2'.
